title: Checkable minimality certificates for Hacker's Delight P1-P25 on a declared ISA
statement: HieraSynth proves 24/25 cost-optimal at n=31-35 with no artifact; Souper cannot synthesize P18, P20-P25. Not one member has a checkable minimality certificate on any ISA. Effort estimate: weeks (P1-P9) to months.
